full_prompt_en: A square screenprint-like illustration shows a tall dark Victorian house beside a steam locomotive under a turquoise sunset sky. Railway tracks enter from the lower left, their dark rails and cross ties bending toward the center where the train stands close to the building. The locomotive has a large circular front and a smokestack, with its metal body rendered in blue-black and small warm highlights. The house rises behind it on the right, three stories of narrow windows, steep roofs, and a small tower stacked into an irregular silhouette. Several windows glow muted amber against the dark walls. Bare or sparsely leaved trees stand beyond the house, their thin branches cutting into pale clouds. Across the upper left, large cream and gray cloud masses gather over a band of peach light at the horizon; tiny birds mark the open blue sky. Long grasses and scrub fill the lower right foreground in pale gray-green strokes, partly hiding the foundations. The whole scene uses tight dark outlines, layered hatch marks, and a limited palette of teal, slate, cream, black, and warm orange. Shapes remain graphic and readable, but rough line texture makes wood siding, metal, clouds, and grass feel weathered. Low sunset light comes from the left horizon, tracing edges of the clouds and picking out small windows, while the near house and train remain in deep blue shadow. The overall composition feels eerie and cinematic, with the curving rails leading toward a crowded dark silhouette beneath luminous sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形丝网印刷般的插画，一座高大深色维多利亚式房屋与蒸汽机车立在青绿色日落天空下。铁轨从左下进入，深色轨道与枕木弯向中央，列车就停在建筑旁。机车有圆形大车头和烟囱，金属车身由蓝黑色与少量暖高光绘出。房屋在其后右侧升起，三层窄窗、陡屋顶和一座小塔叠成不规则剪影。几扇窗在深色墙面上泛出低调琥珀光。稀叶或落叶树立在房屋后方，细枝划进浅色云中。左上方，大块奶油与灰云聚在地平线附近桃色光带之上；几只极小飞鸟点缀开阔蓝天。长草与灌木以浅灰绿笔痕填满右下前景，部分遮住地基。整幅场景使用紧实深轮廓、层叠排线和青绿、石板色、奶油、黑及暖橙构成的有限色盘。形状保持图形化且可读，粗糙线性肌理却让木板、金属、云与草都显得风化。低角度日落光从左侧地平线照来，勾亮云边并点出少量窗光，近处房屋与列车则留在深蓝影中。整体构图怪诞而有电影感，弯曲铁轨导向发光天空下拥挤的深色剪影。
style_prompt_en: The illustration uses a limited screenprint-like palette, dense dark linework, and rough hatching over broad flat color. Turquoise and slate blue dominate shadowed planes; cream clouds and a thin warm orange band provide luminous contrast. Tall irregular silhouettes collect near one side, while a curving linear route guides the eye toward them. Hard architectural edges and delicate branching marks coexist with scratchy organic strokes, producing a weathered tactile finish. Small amber lights punctuate large blue-black masses. Low lateral light brightens the horizon and selected outer edges, leaving the foreground substantially dark. The composition is graphic, moody, and cinematic, with restrained colors carrying strong narrative atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 插画使用有限的丝网印刷般色盘、密集深线和覆盖宽阔平色的粗糙排线。青绿与石板蓝主导阴影平面；奶油色云和细窄暖橙带提供明亮对比。高而不规则的剪影聚在一侧，弯曲线性通道引导视线走向那里。坚硬直边与纤细分叉笔痕并存，擦痕般有机笔触形成风化可触的完成面。小琥珀亮点刺穿大片蓝黑团块。侧向低光提亮地平线与少数外边缘，前景则显著深暗。构图图形性强、情绪浓郁而有电影感，以克制色彩承载强烈叙事氛围。
theme_en: A dark Victorian house beside a steam train at sunset
theme_zh: 日落时蒸汽列车旁的深色维多利亚式房屋
name: Tim Doyle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
